recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No additional core FHIR source work is needed for FHIR-13870 unless a future work group decision changes contained-resource narrative rendering or summary expectations.
issue_request: FHIR-13870 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-core FHIR-I change request for STU3. It requested dropping DomainResource invariant dom-1, which prohibited contained-resource narrative, and adding guidance that relevant information about contained resources must appear in the containing resource narrative because contained-resource narratives are ignored when rendering the containing resource.
initial_application: The issue was applied by a18a11e219deb516933a73c8edf8f8a460f45051 (GF#13870 - allow contained resource narrative), which removed the References page statement that contained resources SHALL NOT contain narrative and added the positive contained-resource narrative rendering rule.
additional_context: DomainResource is active in source/fhir.ini, and current DomainResource constraints include dom-2, dom-3, dom-4, dom-5, and dom-6 with no dom-1. Later same-family issues FHIR-17802 and FHIR-18483 are already represented on the combined branch and handled stale leftover wording from the old no-contained-narrative rule. FHIR-33008 is a later contained-resource reference-direction clarification and does not alter the narrative decision.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current active source has no dom-1 narrative prohibition and source/references.html says contained resources can contain narrative while requiring relevant rendered information to appear in the containing resource narrative.
